title: Use ranked in pickerRows, modelRows and rewindRows instead of hand-rolled fuzzy ranking
notes: pickerRows (src/picker.ts), modelRows (src/chat-commands.ts) and rewindRows (src/chat-rewind.ts) re-spell the score, filter and stable sort that ranked in src/fuzzy.ts already does; effortRows uses it. Cost: a change to how ranked breaks ties reaches /effort but not the picker, /model or /rewind, so the lists drift apart. Each becomes one ranked(...) call (rewindRows over [...points].reverse()). Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/119 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/117#discussion_r4433600528

comments.body: PR #146: pickerRows, modelRows and rewindRows now call ranked; ranked returns early for an empty query. resumeRows, chat-mentions and card-search still score by hand, out of scope.
Shipped in PR #146: the project picker, /model and /rewind rank with ranked; a blank query scores nothing (pinned by test). Merged with main at 2.32.14.
